status: Development design informed by inspected v3-v18a; not independent confirmation or prospective preregistration.
inputs: All6fixedv10local scores plus allv11profiles(24/14/24) plus allv18amain signatures(60/30/180):90/50/210 fields. Same old45/23/41patients and v10roles. Read exact v18aNPZ and round_trip v10/v11CSV after manifest hash verification; preserve feature order. Both old scores retained. No raw support/phase-trial corrections from absent fields.
anchor: Fixed T for Binder/Wielek, originaluHNDI for Mendeley, chosen in earlier development; assignment is not extra-information gain.
calibration: Training-only robust scalar measurement-anchor median/IQR(std/1fallback),asinh. Fit binary logistic slope/intercept with .1ridge toward slope1 and logit((npositive+.5)/(n+1))intercept. Slope constrained>=.05, hence full-training calibration is strictly monotone and preserves within-fold raw-anchorAUC. Fit all leave-one-patient-out calibrators excluding patient's label and scaler contribution; use held-out sigmoid probabilities to form residual y-p and Bernoulli curvature p(1-p). This is a fitted score model, not validated clinical calibration.
calibration_solver: Analytic gradient L-BFGS-B,maxiter500,maxls100,gtol1e-8,ftol1e-12; accept finite fit only with projected-gradientKKT<=1e-6, otherwise preserve technical stop.
geometry: Fit train-only robust asinh twoanchors,tanh extras and v18nearconstant rule. Equal weight three source families, with equal RBF views within each family; bandwidth median positive mean-squared training distances per view(1ifconstant). Anchor nuisance RBF uses bothasinhanchors and its own training median width. Fit kernel ridge with unpenalized intercept, ridge1; training nuisance reference means use exact leave-one-patient-out hatmatrix formula, Hloo_ij=H_ij/(1-H_ii),Hloo_ii=0. D=I-Hloo. Conditional training kernel=D Kextra D^T, querycross=(Kqueryextra-hqueryanchor Kextra)D^T. Query nuisance smoother uses fulltraining only. Retain PSD eigenvalues>maxeig*1e-8, F=V sqrt(eig), queryfeatures=cross V/sqrt(eig). Conditional smoothing does not prove conditional independence or exact nuisance removal.
newton_step: One strictly convex quadratic likelihood step: beta solves [F^T diag(p(1-p))F/n+ridgeI]beta=F^T(y-p)/n. Positive ridge gives unique finite minimizer; residual and curvature use patient-excluded anchor probabilities. This is the quadratic surrogate optimum, not the converged full likelihood optimum. Output full-training calibrated-anchorlogit+tanh(Fquery beta); correction<=1. No causal-estimation or independent-patient-pair theorem claimed.
controls: Withoutcondition uses mean-centered extra kernel only; withoutcrossfit uses in-sample fitted anchor probabilities/curvature but samequerybase and conditionalgeometry. Withoutlatest excludes v18asource, retaining6v10+allv11. Null replaces onlyv18a with its frozen null values, oldv10/v11unchanged. Anchoronly extra kernel uses two oldanchors alone, no supplementary signal. Correctiononly omits queryanchor output, still uses declared baseline-conditioned geometry and supervised residual target, so not baseline-independent information. Calibratedanchor exposes monotone calibration alone. Every kernel version gets identical4configurations except correctiononly3ridge. No modifier selected on outer results.
same_input: All seven learned comparison methods receive exactly two training-scaled oldanchors plus the same unsupervised conditional latent F/Fquery as the main learner. This common upstream includes v18independenthealthy calibration and v10/v11/v18sources, but no clinical labels. Scalar anchorcalibration and residual targets are internal main learner training steps, not extra inputs for comparisons. These comparisons test downstream learners on the same representation, not full clinical official reproductions. ETMC uses anchor view2 and latent viewk plus concat pseudo-view; geometry dimension is determined entirely by trainingpatients.

roboss.implementation: Paper Gaussian-kernel loss,L-BFGS adaptation; not original NAG

splits: Exactly oldv10patient roles in all three cohorts. No heldout signal/label enters any scaler, bandwidth, nuisancefit, spectralbasis,calibrator,correction or selection. No exclusions or changeddiagnoses. Training population quantities may use trainingpatients themselves; only leave-patient-out clinical calibration excludes each querypatient's entire identity.
selection: Mean3innerfoldAUC, ties1e-12 prefer disabledcorrection then strongest ridge1,.1,.01. Calibration/conditional hyperparameters fixed, not tuned after outcomes.
metric: Mean outer-foldAUC, then5seedmean, thenequalcohortmacro. Do not weaken rawT with pooled calibratedOOF comparisons.
performance_target: Positive everyseedmacro vsrawT andoriginaluHNDI, positive5seedmean vsboth in everycohort, positive meanmacro vs measurement_anchor,anchor_only_increment,without_latest_increment,null_latest_increment and without_condition_increment. Report withoutcrossfit and allsameinputrecentmethods; no superiority claim without corresponding comparison evidence and independent confirmation.
novelty_limit: Candidate conditional signal residual kernel, patient-excluded baseline calibration and bounded one-step likelihood correction. Logisticcalibration,kernelridge and Newtonboosting are established constituents; no priority,guaranteedgain,clinical mechanism or double-machine-learning inference theorem claimed. Fullmodel includes absoluteT and originalQC,not end-to-end physicalgain invariant.
